query: Turn our account recovery specification into reviewable GitHub issues. I want thin end-to-end slices, explicit blockers, and a chance to approve the breakdown before anything is published.
이 Linear 프로젝트의 결제 실패 복구 계획을 사람이 리뷰하기 좋은 하위 이슈로 나눠줘. 각 이슈의 검증 방법과 선행 관계도 보여주고 실제 생성은 내가 승인한 뒤에 해줘.
Break epic ENG-482 into agent-ready sub-issues, but optimize the boundaries for human code review rather than agent context size. Include rollout risk and expected PR ordering.

We have a broad spec for customer data export covering permissions, audit logs, CSV generation, and large-job processing. Propose a dependency graph of outcome-focused implementation issues; draft only for now.
Please split this repository-wide identifier migration into safe issues. Every merge must stay green, old clients need a compatibility window, and the cleanup cannot start until all callers move.
대화에서 합의한 웹훅 재시도 기능을 로컬 .scratch 디렉터리 아래 이슈 파일들로 만들어줘. 먼저 분할안과 blocker를 검토받아야 해.
Convert docs/checkout-redesign.md into a set of tracer-bullet work items. Each item should have one observable result, acceptance criteria, verification evidence, non-goals, and minimal dependencies.
Create a reviewable issue breakdown for adding regional retention policies. Security, deletion integrity, staged rollout, and rollback cannot be left as follow-up hardening tasks.
Our roadmap item says 'support imports from three providers'. Split it by useful user outcomes rather than frontend/backend/database tasks and tell me which issues can start in parallel.
Take parent issue #913 and prepare tracker-ready child issue drafts with native blocking relationships where possible. Do not touch GitHub until I approve the exact titles and target repository.
Implement issue ENG-482 exactly as written, update the code and tests, and run the focused test suite. Do not create any new issues.
Review pull request #731 for correctness, security regressions, performance problems, and missing tests. Return findings with file and line references.
Split my current staged changes into three atomic Conventional Commits and write the commit messages, but do not push them.
Write one concise GitHub bug report for the null pointer exception in checkout. Include reproduction steps, expected behavior, actual behavior, and environment details.
List all open Linear issues assigned to me in the current cycle and summarize which ones are blocked.
Explain INVEST and vertical story slicing to a new product manager. Use examples, but do not create a project plan or any issues.
코드베이스를 분석해서 새로운 멀티테넌트 시스템의 전체 아키텍처와 설계 문서 트리를 만들어줘. 아직 이슈 분할은 하지 말자.
Use the to-tickets skill exactly as installed to publish the approved ticket list. Do not substitute another issue-splitting workflow.
Turn my conference preparation notes into a personal checklist for booking travel, finishing slides, and rehearsing. This is not software work and there is no issue tracker.
Triage this production incident now: inspect logs, identify the failing dependency, mitigate customer impact, and report the root cause. Do not stop to create planning issues.
